action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Fix drag-and-drop bug in KanbanBoard.js handleDragEnd function. The issue is that application IDs are being set as status values instead of proper stage IDs (applied, shortlisted, round1, etc.). Also need to clean up corrupted data for Google and Microsoft applications.
